workshoptitle: Building and Operating My AI Staff on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure

tutorials.title: Fast Path: Click the Magic Button
tutorials.description: Alternative to Labs 1 and 2: bootstrap OCI, database, runtime, local plugin, and SELinux labels, then continue with Lab 3

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Prepare OCI Infrastructure and Database (Manual Path)
tutorials.description: Manual deployment path: provision OCI, load the schema snapshot, and validate the vector model

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Install the My AI Staff Runtime (Manual Path)
tutorials.description: Manual deployment path: install dependencies, virtual environments, and SELinux labels

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Configure Slack Agents, Environment Files, and Services
tutorials.description: Import seven Slack apps, configure current identities, and prepare services

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Configure External Services
tutorials.description: Configure Google OAuth, Cloudflare, voice, email, and publishing integrations

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Connect Services and Verify the Deployment
tutorials.description: Activate services and run local, Slack, database, OAuth, and end-to-end verification

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving live help
